_provenance.title: National Statistics UPRN Lookup (January 2024)
_provenance.method: Downloaded the national NSUL_JAN_2024.zip, extracted Data/NSUL_JAN_2024_SE.csv, counted UPRN rows per OA21CD for exactly the 15 OAs relevant to Cholsey/Moulsford identified by P1.4 (see lsoa_overlap fixtures). NOT filtered to residential-only -- NSUL carries no property-type/classification field, so these are whole-address (all use classes) counts. A residential-only split would require AddressBase Premium (a paid OS/GeoPlace product), out of scope for this project -- see the P1.5 worklog entry and ADR-0004.
